root_cause: The restricted app namespace westlake.anl.app.<pid>.N (built by bms app-native-loader create_configured_namespaces) exposes an INCOMPLETE AOSP public-library set. app_search_paths/app_permitted_paths cover only the apk's own libs; bridge_shared_sonames is for the bridge ns; no argument carries the AOSP public-library list into the app ns. Any NDK public lib the app dlopen()s by soname that is not transitively pulled -> ENOENT.
correction_from_outer_0151: Both U10.1T8 and U13 SHIP libicui18n.so in the payload (= libicui18n.z.so, 40766b54). errno=2 = ENOENT in the app ns, NOT a missing file. So U13 first-fatal does not move -> predicted 0.
why_libicuuc_ok_libicui18n_enoent: libicuuc.so is DT_NEEDED by liboh_android_runtime + libandroidfw + libminikin (app-reachable) -> pulled transitively, masking the gap. libicui18n.so is NEEDED only by libminikin/libicu_jni (loaded in the bridge/runtime ns, not re-exported to the app ns by soname), and has no public-lib entry -> ENOENT. The runtime loads both ICU libs RTLD_LOCAL in its own ns (westlake_icu_overrides.cpp:378/385), so those copies are not nameable from the app ns.

minimal_fix.wall1_namespace: Add the missing AOSP public sonames (libicui18n.so, libGLESv2.so, libGLESv3.so, libvulkan.so, libjnigraphics.so) to the app ns as LINKED SHARED LIBRARIES from the platform/default ns -- the same mechanism that already makes libicuuc.so reachable -- in the config passed to create_configured_namespaces (appspawn-x stock child plugin / the deployed appspawn namespace config; app_native_loader.c only forwards it).
minimal_fix.double_copy: Linking by soname resolves to the already-loaded platform copy -> NO second copy. The WRONG fix (adding /system/android/lib64 to app_search_paths) would load a fresh second libicui18n.so (+ a second libicuuc) into the app ns, distinct from the runtime's RTLD_LOCAL copy -> two ICU states/data -> mismatch. Prefer the soname link, not a search path. Do NOT add libandroidio/libjavacore (ART-internal; exposing risks double-loading ART internals).
minimal_fix.wall2_toutiao_only: The ns fix is necessary but not sufficient for toutiao: rebuild deployed libicuuc.so/libicui18n.so with unversioned aliases (U_DISABLE_RENAMING=1 or an alias cohort), or supply the libkryptoni18n.so toutiao looks for first. Separate artifact change.

rule_this_round: errno=2 on dlopen = 'not nameable in this namespace', not 'file absent' -- check the ns public-lib/shared-soname set before concluding missing. One public lib working (libicuuc) can mask the gap via transitive pull. dlopen success does not imply the later dlsym succeeds (symbol versioning = a second wall). And a near ENOENT is a wall only if it causes the fatal (trace ENOENT->between->fatal), not merely by proximity.
